messages:
sarah: kicking off v2 rollout now, canary 10% globally (us/eu). monitoring dashboards up.

deploy-bot: started rollout v2 -> gateway (canary=10%) at 2026-03-20T15:14:48Z

miguel: seeing a spike of 400s from EU mobile clients, quick log excerpt:
```
ERROR 400 /v2/generate - header mismatch: "X-Client" != "x-client" - auth check failed
```

jules: hmm we landed header-case normalization in gateway last night (lower-casing incoming headers). some mobile SDKs rely on exact case for internal proxies.

sarah: confirm when that landed? commit 1a2b3c added normalize-headers middleware to gateway.

kena: can we shim at the gateway to accept original-case too? quick option: accept-case-insensitive lookup in auth layer. I have a patch ready.

miguel: patch would be safest short-term. but risk: we already started traffic; might be faster to pause EU canary and pin mobile routes to v1.

arya: oncall concurs: thresholds breached in eu-west: error rate > 12% for mobile clients (SLO 1%). we should hold and decide.

sarah: proposal: pause rollout in eu regions, apply shim patch (non-breaking) to gateway, then resume. As fallback we can roll back v2 in eu only.

deploy-bot: mark:paused region=eu-west,eu-central for rollout v2 (operator=sarah)

deploy-bot: rollout traffic now -> us-east 10%; eu-west 0% (paused)

jules: i'll push the shim to staging for quick smoke. patch snippet:
```
// gateway auth lookup
let hdr = req.headers['x-client'] || req.headers['X-Client'] || req.headers['X-client'];
if (!hdr) return 400;
```

kena: that works. can someone update release notes and notify partner teams? release notes should mention header normalization was intended but we added shim for backcompat and will roll out a formal deprecation later.

sarah: @jules please update /docs/releases/v2.md and post an announcement in #announcements once stable.

jules: done. PR 3245 updates notes + rollout strategy. also added rollback criteria: if mobile error rate > 5% for 5m or client auth failures > 0.5% we'll auto-rollback eu regions.

deploy-bot: link: PR 3245

miguel: after applying shim to canary gateway in eu-staging, mobile smoke passed. want to canary the shim behind feature flag and resume eu at 5%.

sarah: do it. nile (sre) please watch and be ready to trigger rollback.

arya: watching. escalation path: if rollback triggered, oncall page + slack alert + postmortem owner auto-assigned.

deploy-bot: resume canary v2 in eu-west -> 5% (operator=sarah)

miguell: typo in last message? miguEl? (just kidding)

miguel: lol

sarah: if anything looks off, we'll cut a regional rollback. good catch team — quick response. :thumbsup:
